app.offline.title.description: Bold lead-in of the banner shown while the device has no network

app.offline.body.defaultMessage: Saved pages still open. We'll catch up when you're back online.

app.update.message.defaultMessage: A new version of TodayZ Admin is ready.
app.update.message.description: Toast shown when a new version of the app is waiting. The page never reloads until the person taps Update, and never while a sale or checkout is open.

app.update.action.description: Button in the update toast; reloads the app

app.error.title.description: Heading of the screen shown when the app crashes

app.error.body.defaultMessage: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.

app.pending.retry.description: Button under the offline notice when the first sign-in check could not reach the server

app.loading.description: Spoken while the app checks whether you are signed in

auth.signIn.sub.defaultMessage: Use your staff mobile number. We'll send a code by SMS.

auth.phone.label.description: Label of the phone field. The +91 prefix is shown beside it.

auth.phone.help.description: Help text under the phone field

auth.phone.invalid.defaultMessage: Enter a 10-digit mobile number that starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9.

auth.code.send.description: Button that sends the SMS code

auth.code.sending.description: Spoken while the code is being sent

auth.code.label.description: Name of the group of six code boxes

auth.code.digit.description: Name of code box number {position}, 2 to 6

auth.code.sentTo.description: Line above the code boxes. {phone} is the number with some digits hidden.

auth.code.verifying.description: Spoken while the code is being checked

auth.code.resend.description: Button to ask for a new code

auth.code.resendIn.description: Disabled button while the resend timer runs. {seconds} counts down.

auth.code.change.description: Button that goes back to the phone field

auth.error.wrongCode.defaultMessage: That code is not right. Check it and try again.

auth.error.expired.defaultMessage: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.

auth.error.locked.defaultMessage: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new code.
auth.error.locked.description: Too many wrong attempts on one code

auth.error.signinLocked.defaultMessage: Too many wrong codes for this number. Sign-in is locked for now. Try again later, or ask another super admin to unlock it.
auth.error.signinLocked.description: Admin sign-in locked after too many wrong codes across requests (D-264); another super admin can unlock it on Admin users

auth.error.rateLimited.defaultMessage: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.

auth.error.blocked.defaultMessage: This account can't sign in right now. Contact support.

auth.error.network.defaultMessage: We can't reach TodayZ. Check your connection and try again.
auth.error.network.description: No network or the server did not answer

auth.error.generic.defaultMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.error.captcha.defaultMessage: We couldn't check that you are a person. Reload the page and try again.
auth.error.captcha.description: The bot check (Turnstile, or reCAPTCHA when Firebase sends the code) failed to load or run

auth.error.methodChanged.defaultMessage: We changed how sign-in codes are sent. Please send the code again.
auth.error.methodChanged.description: D-275: the sign-in code service (SMS or Firebase) changed while the page was open

auth.firebase.recaptchaNotice.defaultMessage: This sign-in is protected by Google reCAPTCHA. Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.
auth.firebase.recaptchaNotice.description: Small print under the send-code button when Firebase sends the code (D-275); reCAPTCHA's terms require it

auth.signOut.description: Button that ends the session on this device

auth.stepUp.send.description: Step-up dialog: button that sends a fresh 6-digit code by SMS to the admin's own staff number (D-264)

auth.stepUp.sending.description: Step-up dialog: accessible label of the send button while the SMS is being sent

auth.stepUp.sent.defaultMessage: We sent a code by SMS to your staff number.
auth.stepUp.sent.description: Step-up dialog: shown above the code boxes once the SMS is on its way

auth.stepUp.codeLabel.description: Step-up dialog: label of the 6-digit code boxes

auth.stepUp.resend.description: Step-up dialog: button that sends another SMS code

auth.stepUp.resendIn.description: Step-up dialog: disabled resend button while the wait between codes runs; seconds counts down

auth.stepUp.wrong.defaultMessage: That code is not right. Check the SMS and try again.
auth.stepUp.wrong.description: Step-up dialog: the code did not match

auth.stepUp.wrongLeft.defaultMessage: That code is not right. {count, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
auth.stepUp.wrongLeft.description: Step-up dialog: the code did not match; count is how many tries are left for this code

auth.stepUp.expired.defaultMessage: That code has expired or was already used. Send a new code.
auth.stepUp.expired.description: Step-up dialog: the code is older than 5 minutes, already used, or not this admin's

auth.stepUp.locked.defaultMessage: Too many wrong codes. You have been signed out; sign in again.
auth.stepUp.locked.description: Step-up dialog: the fifth wrong code ended every admin session of this person

auth.stepUp.signInAgain.description: Step-up dialog: button shown after the lockout; goes to sign-in

auth.stepUp.rateLimited.defaultMessage: Too many codes asked for. Wait before you ask for another.
auth.stepUp.rateLimited.description: Step-up dialog: the number or this network has had too many codes; the resend button counts down the wait

auth.stepUp.unavailable.defaultMessage: We couldn't send or check the code. Try again in a moment.
auth.stepUp.unavailable.description: Step-up dialog: any other failure (network, server)
